scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hmm...?
Oh, hello there~
I am Shi Yan Wen, the chief of
this village. Allow me to personally welcome you to Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...？
啊，你好~
我是石延文，這座村莊的首領。
請允許我親自歡迎您來到崑崙。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Although our village hasn't
associated with other towns very
much, we have recently begun
to allow visitors coming from Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
雖然我們的村莊與其他城鎮
來往不多，但最近
我們開始允許來自艾爾貝塔的
訪客了。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I feel that this town has been
isolated for too long. Because
of that, people in this town aren't too friendly with visitors yet.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我覺得這座城鎮
已經與世隔絕太久了。
因此，這裡的人
對訪客還不太友好。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Moreover, we've been having a recent problem with thieves
that have been enjoying themselves far too much in Kunlun...
Well, you've come to visit here
so I hope you enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
而且，最近我們遇到了一個問題，
有些竊賊在崑崙
玩得太過分了...
既然您來這裡做客，
希望您能玩得盡興。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, it's you~
How do you like it here so far?
As you've probably noticed,
the village isn't that peaceful, huh?
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
啊，是你~
你覺得這裡怎麼樣？
你應該也注意到了，
這個村莊並不太平，對吧？

scripts.text: It's alright.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼問題。

scripts.text: I heard that something was stolen...
scripts.translation: 我聽說有東西被偷了...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Well, I'm glad you don't mind.
Just watch out for robbers,
and try not to act suspicious
in the village.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
很好，你不介意就好。
只要小心強盜，
並且在村莊裡
不要做出可疑的行為。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hmm...you've heard of it?
It was just last night when the
robbery occurred. The rumors
are true. Sadly, there are lots of thieves out there in the village...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...你聽說了？
就在昨晚發生了搶劫。
傳聞是真的。不幸的是，
村裡有很多竊賊...

scripts.text: What was stolen?
scripts.translation: 被偷了什麼？

scripts.text: Was anyone hurt?
scripts.translation: 有人受傷嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I can't believe it really
happened... Well, if you see
any suspicious characters around,
or find what was stolen, please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
真不敢相信
這真的發生了... 如果你看到
任何可疑的人，
或者找到了被偷的東西，
請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Well...
Erm...it was...
...just an ordinary sword.
But to us, it's been a family treasure for many generations.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...
那個...那是...
...只是一把普通的劍。
但對我們來說，
它是傳了很多代的家族寶物。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I must find this sword
no matter what!
...but I can't go find it just
by myself. I'm just too busy.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
無論如何
我必須找到這把劍！
...但我不能一個人去找。
我太忙了。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
You know how busy it is to be the
chief of a village. This is very troubling...*Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
你知道當村莊首領
有多忙。這真是令人煩惱...*嘆氣*

scripts.text: Hope you find it soon.
scripts.translation: 希望你能儘快找到。

scripts.text: Can I find it for you?
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你找嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
um..Thank you.
If you somehow come across it,
please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...謝謝。
如果你碰巧找到了，
請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh!~ Are you serious??
...The people in the village are
very fearful these days because
of the thieves. It is so difficult
to ask them for help...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦！~你是認真的嗎？？
...最近因為竊賊，
村裡的人都很害怕。
很難讓他們幫忙...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
If you would help me find the sword, I will surely repay you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你能幫我找到那把劍，我一定會報答你的。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Fortunately, no one was hurt.
However, the thieves took a
valuable family treasure
which has been passed down from
generation to generation.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
幸好沒有人受傷。
但是，盜賊們搶走了
一件代代相傳的
珍貴家傳寶物。

scripts.text:

I must find this sword
no matter what!
...But I can't go find it just
by myself. I'm just too busy.
scripts.translation:

我實在太忙了。

哦！~你是認真的嗎？？
...最近因為竊賊，
村裡的人都很害怕。
很難讓他們幫忙...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
If you would help me find the sword, I will surely repay you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你能幫我找到那把劍，我一定會報答你的。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Haven't found it yet?
There's no rush, take it easy.
You have to take care of
youself first before
doing favors for others.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
還沒找到嗎？
不用著急，慢慢來。
在幫助別人之前，
你得先照顧好自己。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, you found a clue?
So far, it looks like
you're doing good work.
Take this old family medicine, it might be of use sometime soon.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，你找到線索了？
目前看來，
你做得很好。
拿著這個祖傳的藥，
也許很快用得上。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
It might be helpful for you to
know that the thief sustained
an injury, so he is probably not very far from here.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
告訴你一個可能有幫助的資訊：
那個盜賊受了傷，
所以他應該離這裡不遠。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
What...?
My sword has been broken!?
Unbelievable~!!
How could this happen??
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
什麼...？
我的劍斷了！？
難以置信~！！
怎麼會這樣？？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
First it's stolen, and now
it's in pieces... *Sob*
Would you please search
for the rest of my sword?
It means so much to my family...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
先是被盜，現在又碎了... *抽泣*
你能幫我找找
我劍的碎片嗎？
這對我的家族意義重大...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
*Sob*...
...my sword... in pieces...
I beg of you, please find them
for me. I will give you something in return.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
*抽泣*...
...我的劍...碎了...
求求你，請幫我找到它們。
我會給你一些回報。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh!~
You've found the pieces for me~
I knew you could do it.
But the sword is still shattered.
What shall I do...?
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦！~
你幫我找到了碎片~
我就知道你能做到。
但劍還是碎的。
我該怎麼辦...？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
If it's okay with you,
would you repair my sword for me?
I'll repay you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你不介意的話，
能幫我修好這把劍嗎？
我會報答你的幫助。

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Well, I see...you've been such a
nice person. I truly appreciate
your hard work. It would be
wonderful if you could help
me repair the sword, but I
will not force you.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯，我明白了...你真是個
好人。我非常感激
你的辛勤工作。如果你能
幫我修好這把劍，那就太好了，
但我不會強迫你。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I'll find some way to repair
it. Without your help, I 
would have never found it.
Please accept this as a
token of my gratitude...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我會想辦法修好它的。沒有你的幫助，
我根本找不到它。
請收下這個，
作為我的謝禮...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
If you find any information
or clues about that cursed
thief, please let me know.
I have my sword back but
there's no way I can forgive
this affront to my ancestors...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你找到任何關於
那個被詛咒的盜賊的
資訊或線索，請告訴我。
雖然我的劍回來了，
但我絕不能原諒
這種對我祖先的侮辱...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Such generosity...
I'm truly indebted to you...
I have no idea how this sword
broke into pieces, though.
You will probably need to find a
famous blacksmith to repair it.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如此慷慨...
我真的感激不盡...
不過，我不知道這把劍
是怎麼碎的。
你可能需要找一位
著名的鐵匠來修理它。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
As I already mentioned, this is
an important family treasure...
Oh! I just remembered--
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
正如我之前所說，這是
一件重要的家傳寶物...
哦！我突然想起來——

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
There's a guy named ^555555Zuo Hei^000000
in the village. He has been to
many places around the world.
He may know of such a weaponsmith. Please seek this man out.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
村裡有個叫^555555左黑^000000的人。
他去過世界上很多地方。
他可能認識這樣的武器匠人。請去找這個人。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, one last thing. This is
but a trinket, but please
accept this gift from me.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，還有一件事。這只是
一件小禮物，但請
收下我這份心意。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
The village is not in a good
mood these days, but there are
still lots of things to see in Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
最近村裡的氣氛不太好，
但崑崙還有很多
值得看的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hmm.. no traces? No clues?
... Nothing? Well, that's
alright. Thank you for
trying to help.
Hmm....
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...沒有痕跡？沒有線索？
...什麼都沒有嗎？沒關係。
謝謝你願意幫忙。
嗯....

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Here...take this.
Have a good time in Kunlun~
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
給...拿著這個。
祝你在崑崙玩得開心~

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Is everything going well?
The village has not been
in a good mood, lately.
Still, please try to
enjoy yourself.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
一切都還好嗎？
最近村裡的氣氛不太好。
不過，請儘量玩得盡興。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I really appreciate what you are
doing. It's a big relief that
something is finally being done
about these thefts.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我非常感激你所做的一切。
終於有人開始處理這些盜竊案了，
這讓我鬆了一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Perhaps now, peace will finally
come to the village, just like in the old days...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
也許現在，村莊終於能像從前那樣
恢復安寧了...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I appreciate what you are doing,
and your help has been
a relief to me. The Village
seems less tense, much like
it was in the old days.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我很感激你的所作所為，
你的幫助讓我感到寬慰。
村莊的氣氛似乎沒那麼緊張了，
就像從前一樣。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Although I hope you'll be
be able to repair my
sword soon, you've
already done so much for
me. I feel sorry for
asking you to do more.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
雖然我希望你能儘快
修復我的劍，但你已經
為我做了很多。讓你再費心，
我感到很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hm.....
Not finished yet, huh?
Still, it's good to know
it's being repaired...
I'll be waiting, then.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯.....
還沒修好嗎？
不過，知道它正在被修復
就好...
那我等著。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, it's you~ Hello.
............
Is that my sword?
Wow, you've done it!
Good work!
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，是你~ 你好。
............
那是我的劍嗎？
哇，你做到了！
幹得好！

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
This is a small gift for you.
Please take it as thanks for a job well done!
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
這是給你的小禮物。
請收下，以感謝你的出色工作！

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Thank you for all of your efforts.
With this sword repaired, I no
longer feel that I am shaming
my ancestors...
Heh heh...
Have a good time in Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
感謝你的所有付出。
有了這把修復好的劍，
我不再覺得愧對祖先了...
嘿嘿...
祝你在崑崙玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, it's you~
Once again, I'd like to thank
you for all of your help.
Enjoy your stay in our village.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，是你~
再次感謝你的所有幫助。
祝你在我們村莊住得愉快。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oh...you're new here, right?
Came from out of town?
It's common to see lots of
foreigners these days.
It made people in the village busy.
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
哦...你是新來的吧？
從外地來的？
最近經常看到很多外地人。
這讓村裡的人忙壞了。

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oh, what am I saying...
Want some wine?
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
哎呀，我在說什麼呢...
想喝點酒嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please
scripts.translation: 好的，請給我

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oooops~! Oh no...
A lot of customers came by earlier,
so now we're out of wine...
It's getting difficult to keep up with the increasing number of customers...
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
哎呀~！糟糕...
剛才來了很多顧客，
現在酒賣完了...
顧客越來越多，真難應付啊...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Well, have fun in the village.
Stop by again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
嗯，在村裡玩得開心。
有空再來。

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Hey, you know what?
The chief's house was robbed
last night. I can't believe
this happened...I guess this is the work of those thieves...
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
嘿，你知道嗎？
昨晚首領的家被偷了。
真不敢相信會發生這種事...我想這是那些小偷乾的...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
How worrisome it all is...
It could even happen to me!
I better watch out...
Oh, what am I saying?
Enjoy your time in my shop...hehe~
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
真讓人擔心...
這種事甚至可能發生在我身上！
我得小心點...
哎呀，我在說什麼？
在我的店裡玩得開心...嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oh, it's you again~
I heard that you've decided
to help our chief.
Please do your best for him!
Everyone in the village has
been on edge...
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
哦，又是你~
我聽說你決定幫助我們的首領。
請為他加油吧！
村裡的人都提心吊膽的...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Do you see that guy over there
leaning on the table?
He seems to know about what
happened last night, but...
He's been drinking all night long.
scripts.translation:
[梅豔芳]
你看到那邊靠在桌子上的那個男人了嗎？
他似乎知道昨晚發生了什麼，但是...
他整晚都在喝酒。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
那把刀是我因為疏忽而弄丟的。它屬於我的
一位祖先。我知道它看起來像
一把廉價的刀……

scripts.text:
[Han Ran Jiao]
But it has been in the
family for a very long time.
Would you please return that
knife to me?
scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
但它已經在家族中
傳承很久了。
請你把那把刀還給我好嗎？

scripts.text: Return the knife.
scripts.translation: 歸還那把刀

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Han Ran Jiao]
Thank you! Thank you so much!
Please take these potions.
They may not be much, but they
are the best I can give you.
scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
謝謝！太感謝了！
請收下這些藥水。
雖然不多，但這是我
能給你的最好的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Han Ran Jiao]
You kept my family heirloom safe!
I give you my deepest gratitude
for returning this.
scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
你保護了我家的傳家寶！
對於歸還此物，我
向你致以最誠摯的謝意。

scripts.text:
[Han Ran Jiao]
No~! My family heirloom!!
You scoundrel! May the spirits
forever haunt you! My curse shall be upon your head!
scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
不~！我家的傳家寶！！
你這個無賴！願精靈
永遠纏上你！我的詛咒將降臨在你頭上！

scripts.text:
[Han Ran Jiao]
Oh no! What will I do?
I can't believe I dropped
my irreplaceable knife! Ahhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
天哪！我該怎麼辦？！
我竟然把無可替代的刀弄丟了！啊~~~~！

scripts.text:
[Han Ran Jiao]
I need to go down to get it
but...the monsters...
I'm so scared... What should I do?!
scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
我得下去把它撿回來，但是……那些魔物……
我好害怕……我該怎麼辦？！

scripts.text:
[Han Ran Jiao]
My neighbor seemed looked pretty bothered about something...
Oh well, I have better things to worry about than his fancy tea.
scripts.translation:
[韓然嬌]
我的鄰居看起來好像很煩惱……
算了，比起他那些花哨的茶，
我有更值得擔心的事。
